name: copyMessage

parameters.name: chat_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target bot, supergroup, or channel in the format @username

parameters.name: message_thread_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the target message thread (topic) of a forum; for forum supergroups and private chats of bots with forum topic mode enabled only

parameters.name: direct_messages_topic_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the direct messages topic to which the message will be sent; required if the message is sent to a direct messages chat

parameters.name: from_chat_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the chat where the original message was sent (or username of the target bot, supergroup, or channel in the format @username)

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: Message identifier in the chat specified in from_chat_id

parameters.name: video_start_timestamp
parameters.description: New start timestamp for the copied video in the message

parameters.name: caption
parameters.description: New caption for media, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing. If not specified, the original caption is kept.

parameters.name: parse_mode
parameters.description: Mode for parsing entities in the new caption. See formatting options for more details.

parameters.name: caption_entities
parameters.description: A JSON-serialized list of special entities that appear in the new caption, which can be specified instead of parse_mode

parameters.name: show_caption_above_media
parameters.description: Pass True if the caption must be shown above the message media. Ignored if a new caption isn't specified.

parameters.name: disable_notification
parameters.description: Sends the message silently. Users will receive a notification with no sound.

parameters.name: protect_content
parameters.description: Protects the contents of the sent message from forwarding and saving

parameters.name: allow_paid_broadcast
parameters.description: Pass True to allow up to 1000 messages per second, ignoring broadcasting limits for a fee of 0.1 Telegram Stars per message. The relevant Stars will be withdrawn from the bot's balance.

parameters.name: message_effect_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the message effect to be added to the message; only available when copying to private chats

parameters.name: suggested_post_parameters
parameters.description: A JSON-serialized object containing the parameters of the suggested post to send; for direct messages chats only. If the message is sent as a reply to another suggested post, then that suggested post is automatically declined.

parameters.name: reply_parameters
parameters.description: Description of the message to reply to

parameters.name: reply_markup
parameters.type: InlineKeyboardMarkup or ReplyKeyboardMarkup or ReplyKeyboardRemove or ForceReply
parameters.description: Additional interface options. A JSON-serialized object for an inline keyboard, custom reply keyboard, instructions to remove a reply keyboard or to force a reply from the user.

description: Use this method to copy messages of any kind. Service messages, paid media messages, giveaway messages, giveaway winners messages, invoice messages, and widget messages can't be copied. A quiz poll can be copied only if the value of the field correct_option_ids is known to the bot. The method is analogous to the method forwardMessage, but the copied message doesn't have a link to the original message. Returns the MessageId of the sent message on success.
